exposure: implementation of a protocol/policy promoting vaginal delivery for breech presentation
cohort: The study included 245 singleton pregnancies with podalic (breech) presentation and a gestational age of more than 32 weeks, comparing 135 patients who gave birth in 2008 with 110 patients who gave birth in 2014.
finding: An incentive policy promoting vaginal delivery for breech presentation successfully limited the rate of planned and emergency caesarean sections without negatively impacting neonatal morbidity or mortality.
mod_finding: The incentive policy significantly increased the rate of successful vaginal birth trials (from 32.7% to 63.8%) and decreased both planned (by 16.3%) and emergency (by 6.2%) caesarean sections for breech presentation.
